COMPOUND QUERY
  LEFT-MOST SUBQUERY
    SEARCH i USING INDEX image_collection (collection_id=? AND kind=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 1
      SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
  UNION ALL
    SEARCH c USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_collection_1 (id=?)
    LIST SUBQUERY 7
      SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 8
      SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX image_collection (collection_id=? AND kind=?)
    SEARCH i USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_image_1 (id=?)
    CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 6
      SEARCH cw USING PRIMARY KEY (collection_id=?)
      SEARCH w USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
      CORRELATED SCALAR SUBQUERY 4
        SEARCH vr USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_work_1 (id=?)
      SEARCH wi USING INDEX image_work (work_id=? AND kind=?)
      SEARCH vl EXISTS USING COVERING INDEX work_library_work (work_id=?)
      LIST SUBQUERY 3
        SCAN json_each VIRTUAL TABLE INDEX 1:
        CREATE BLOOM FILTER
      USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
